title: Advanced Materials & Physics
businessQuestion: How does AI-accelerated crystal and catalyst discovery shorten materials commercialization?
investorQuestion: Which specialty material formulations hold un-commoditized supply chain positions?
overview: Every record here is at proof of concept — this is the purest research bucket in the catalogue. Company coverage is broad because materials suppliers sit upstream of many value chains, but commercial timing is usually gated by qualification cycles measured in years. Watch design wins and sampling agreements rather than press releases.
